description_en: Describes the configurations of file shares on a file gateway
description_zh: 获取文件网关上共享的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun sgw describe-gateway-file-shares --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbvq000 --index-id NFSd-million --refresh true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGatewayFileShares

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file share. If you leave this parameter empty, the configurations of all file shares on the gateway are returned
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享的ID。如果该字段为空，则枚举该网关上的所有文件共享的配置信息
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly refresh the cache. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制刷新缓存。默认值：false
parameters.name: refresh
